items.name: TLRHS @0x1A753 scale
items.claim_tested: TLRHS LSB = 0.1 s (stock 0x14 → 2.0 s) because counter ticks once per 100 ms task

sites.text: ADDB 0xA7EA,ONES (decrement while FD48.1 set and A7EA≠0)

evidence_1_consumer.note: Reload when FD48.1 clear; decrement when FD48.1 set — timebase = call period of this function, not the bit itself

role_ok: FR LREB p.329/335: TLRHS FW = blocking time LC during hot start (TASHS/TMSHS); operates as of end of start
FR LREB100MS: 'Activation conditions for control upstream catalyst determined in the 100 ms cycle'
FR B_stend examples: end-of-start condition (not a time quantum)

real_code_writer.context: after temp/map compares; paired BCLR FD48.0; clear path @0x870F4C 1E24

FD48_1_what_sets.foreign_A2L: E650 MEASUREMENT B_stend @ ECU_ADDRESS 0xFD48 BIT_MASK 0x2 (=bit1) — перенесено; matches bit index, labels level 'Startende', NOT 100ms tick
FD48_1_what_sets.data_island_false_hits: many raw 1F24 in non-code regions (e.g. 0x8122B0) — ignore without coherent decode context

fail_for_PROVEN_scale: No 6901 instruction proves the enclosing task that calls 0x87508A runs at 100 ms
Far-pointer table hit 8A508700 @0x816DAC is STRUCT (dispatcher table candidate) without proven raster ID→100ms binding
E650 TLRHS conversion t100msxs_ub_b25p5 (0.1 s/LSB) is transfer, not 6901 proof
FD48.1 gates on B_stend-level semantics (FR+foreign A2L) — does not supply LSB period

evidence_3_falsifiers.falsifier: If 0x1A753 were not reload source, EXTP MOVB 0x2753 under page 206 would resolve elsewhere
If FD48.1 were a 100ms tick generator, it would be toggled by a periodic timer ISR/task each quantum rather than set/cleared by start-end logic @0x870F28
evidence_3_falsifiers.note: Setter is start/condition logic; FR B_stend = end of start. Tick hypothesis for the bit fails; task-period for 87508A still unproven → scale remains STRUCT

evidence_3_falsifiers.falsifier: If counter decremented in multiple rasters, A7EA would have other writers/decs
evidence_3_falsifiers.result: DID_NOT_FIRE for extra sites — only 8750xx touches A7EA (supports single-task tick, still unknown period)
